## Overview Add an opt-in ROCm compile pass that fuses an unquantized GEMM into the residual add + RMSNorm that consumes it (`-cc.pass_config.fuse_gemm_add_rms=True`, compile ranges of at most 256 tokens). When the GEMM runs as an AITER Triton split-K GEMM, the fp32 partials go straight into AITER's `fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm`, so the split-K reduce kernel and the add + RMSNorm kernel become one kernel. See the companion AITER PR: https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6678 ## Claims - Qwen3.8-27B BF16, TP1, MI355X, 1024×1024: per decoder layer, the split-K reduce (4.5 µs) and the add + RMSNorm (4.7 µs) after o_proj / out_proj become one 4.6 µs kernel. - The gain needs a GEMM that splits K at decode sizes. Here, the AITER Triton config for N=5120, K=6144 (Qwen3.8 o_proj and out_proj) uses 3 splits for M=9–64. Where the GEMM does not split K (e.g. down_proj on hipBLASLt), the pass only swaps Inductor's add + RMSNorm for the AITER kernel at the same launch count. - Off by default at every optimization level; no change for CUDA, XPU or other ROCm configurations. Before: After: ## Validation Environment: MI355X, `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly` of 2026-10-05 (vLLM 92044241a0, aiter 0.1.24.post1 + ROCm/aiter#6156 + ROCm/aiter#6678). The PR side adds `-cc.pass_config.fuse_gemm_add_rms=True` to the serve command. | Concurrency | | Baseline | PR | Δ | |--:|--|--:|--:|--:| | 4 | Total tok/s | 586.2 | 591.5 | +0.9% | | | Mean TPOT (ms) | 13.47 | 13.35 | −0.9% | | | Mean TTFT (ms) | 193.0 | 194.6 | +0.8% | | 16 | Total tok/s | 2040.0 | 2078.9 | +1.9% | | | Mean TPOT (ms) | 15.17 | 14.85 | −2.1% | | | Mean TTFT (ms) | 542.4 | 567.1 | +4.6% | | 32 | Total tok/s | 3432.6 | 3449.4 | +0.5% | | | Mean TPOT (ms) | 17.85 | 17.78 | −0.4% | | | Mean TTFT (ms) | 829.2 | 801.1 | -3.4% | | 64 | Total tok/s | 5580.8 | 5620.9 | +0.7% | | | Mean TPOT (ms) | 21.88 | 21.72 | −0.7% | | | Mean TTFT (ms) | 1098.4 | 1086.1 | -1.1% | | — | GSM8K flexible / strict (5-shot, n = 1319) | 0.7248 / 0.6990 | 0.7278 / 0.6998 | - | Tests: `tests/compile/passes/test_rocm_aiter_gemm_add_rms_fusion.py`, 5/5 pass on MI355X: - `test_fuse_gemm_add_rms` checks that the pattern matches (both plain RMSNorm and GemmaRMSNorm) with the AITER op available (if kernel doesn't exist in the pinned AITER, these cases are skipped). If not available, nothing is matched and the unfused ops are kept. Checks that the new kernel receives the correct partials and that numerics match the unfused model. - `test_fuse_gemm_add_rms_compile_range`: checks that the flag alone yields compile ranges 1–256 and 257–8192. Reproduce: ``` # vLLM Serve vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --language-model-only --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \ -cc.use_inductor_graph_partition=True -cc.pass_config.fuse_gemm_add_rms=True # vLLM Bench vllm bench serve --model Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 1024 \ --random-range-ratio 0 --ignore-eos --num-prompts 640 --max-concurrency <4/16/32/64> --temperature 0.0 --top-p 1.0 ``` ## Details - `rocm_unquantized_gemm_impl` becomes a wrapper over `_rocm_unquantized_gemm(..., skip_reduce=False)`. Only the two branches that reach AITER's Triton `gemm_a16w16` honour `skip_reduce`: the direct Triton branch, and the tuned (`tgemm`) branch when AITER's tuned config for the shape says `triton`. Those return the `[num_ksplit, M, N]` fp32 partials; every other branch returns the normal output. The registered `rocm_unquantized_gemm` op is unchanged. - `rocm_aiter_gemm_add_rmsnorm(x, weight, residual, norm_weight, eps, gemma_norm)` runs the GEMM with `skip_reduce` and passes the result (partials or the reduced output) to `fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm`. - Pattern matches `rocm_unquantized_gemm` → `vllm_ir.fused_add_rms_norm`, for RMSNorm and GemmaRMSNorm. The plain form requires the weight dtype to equal the activation dtype (`_rms_input_weight_dtype_match`), so it never binds Gemma's fp32 `(w + 1)` and leaves the `+1` as a separate kernel. Runs before the RMSNorm + quant passes. - Compile ranges up to `pass_config.gemm_add_rms_fusion_max_token_num` (default is 256) tokens for decode, where split-K configs apply. Prefill keeps Inductor's kernels. ---

(Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

@@ -0,0 +1,192 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+import vllm.config
+from tests.compile.backend import TestBackend
+from vllm._aiter_ops import is_aiter_found_and_supported, rocm_aiter_ops
+from vllm.compilation.passes.fx_utils import find_op_nodes
+from vllm.compilation.passes.utility.noop_elimination import NoOpEliminationPass
+from vllm.compilation.passes.utility.post_cleanup import PostCleanupPass
+from vllm.config import (
+    CompilationConfig,
+    CompilationMode,
+    ModelConfig,
+    PassConfig,
+    VllmConfig,
+)
+from vllm.config.scheduler import SchedulerConfig
+from vllm.config.utils import Range
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.layernorm import GemmaRMSNorm, RMSNorm
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.utils import rocm_unquantized_gemm
+
+
+class TestModel(torch.nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, num_layers: int, hidden_size: int, k: int, gemma_norm: bool):
+        super().__init__()
+        norm_cls = GemmaRMSNorm if gemma_norm else RMSNorm
+        self.norm = [norm_cls(hidden_size, eps=1e-6) for _ in range(num_layers)]
+        for norm in self.norm:
+            torch.nn.init.normal_(norm.weight, std=0.1)
+        self.weight = [torch.randn(hidden_size, k) / k**0.5 for _ in range(num_layers)]
+
+    def forward(self, x, residual):
+        # avoid having graph inputs be pattern args directly
+        x = torch.relu(x)
+        residual = torch.relu(residual)
+        outs = []
+        for norm, weight in zip(self.norm, self.weight):
+            h = rocm_unquantized_gemm(self, x, weight)
+            out, residual = norm(h, residual)
+            outs.append(out)
+        return residual, *outs
+
+    def ops_in_model_before(self):
+        return [
+            torch.ops.vllm.rocm_unquantized_gemm.default,
+            torch.ops.vllm_ir.fused_add_rms_norm,
+        ]
+
+    def ops_in_model_after(self):
+        return [rocm_aiter_ops.get_gemm_add_rmsnorm_op()]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.bfloat16])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_layers", [3])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("gemma_norm", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fused_op_available", [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_tokens", [16])
+# AITER's gfx950 Triton config for N=256, K=7168 splits K at M <= 16.
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("hidden_size, k", [(256, 7168)])
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not is_aiter_found_and_supported(),
+    reason="Only test on ROCm with AITER installed and supported",
+)
+def test_fuse_gemm_add_rms(
+    dtype: torch.dtype,
+    num_layers: int,
+    gemma_norm: bool,
+    fused_op_available: bool,
+    num_tokens: int,
+    hidden_size: int,
+    k: int,
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+):
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+
+    if not on_gfx950():
+        pytest.skip("The AITER tuned GEMM dispatch is gfx950-only")
+
+    vllm_config = VllmConfig(
+        model_config=ModelConfig(dtype=dtype),
+        compilation_config=CompilationConfig(
+            mode=CompilationMode.VLLM_COMPILE,
+            custom_ops=["+rms_norm"],
+            pass_config=PassConfig(fuse_gemm_add_rms=True, eliminate_noops=True),
+        ),
+    )
+
+    if (
+        fused_op_available
+        and not rocm_aiter_ops.is_fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm_supported()
+    ):
+        pytest.skip("Needs AITER's fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm (ROCm/aiter#6678)")
+
+    with vllm.config.set_current_vllm_config(vllm_config), monkeypatch.context() as m:
+        from vllm.compilation.passes.fusion.rocm_aiter_fusion import (
+            RocmAiterGemmAddRMSNormFusionPass,
+        )
+
+        torch.set_default_device("cuda")
+        torch.set_default_dtype(dtype)
+        torch.manual_seed(1)
+
+        m.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER", "1")
+        m.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_USE_SKINNY_GEMM", "0")
+        rocm_aiter_ops.refresh_env_variables()
+        if not fused_op_available:
+            m.setattr(
+                rocm_aiter_ops, "is_fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm_supported", lambda: False
+            )
+        # Route the GEMM through the AITER Triton kernel whatever the tuned CSV says.
+        m.setattr(
+            "vllm.model_executor.layers.utils._aiter_tuned_gemm_libtype",
+            lambda *args: "triton",
+        )
+        input_ranks: list[int] = []
+        if fused_op_available:
+            from aiter.ops.triton.normalization import fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm as mod
+
+            fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm = mod.fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm
+
+            def spy(x, *args, **kwargs):
+                input_ranks.append(x.dim())
+                return fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm(x, *args, **kwargs)
+
+            m.setattr(mod, "fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm", spy)
+
+        fusion_pass = RocmAiterGemmAddRMSNormFusionPass(vllm_config)
+        passes = [
+            NoOpEliminationPass(vllm_config),
+            fusion_pass,
+            PostCleanupPass(vllm_config),
+        ]
+        backend = TestBackend(*passes)
+        model = TestModel(num_layers, hidden_size, k, gemma_norm)
+
+        x = torch.randn(num_tokens, k)
+        residual = torch.randn(num_tokens, hidden_size)
+        torch._dynamo.mark_dynamic(x, 0)
+        torch._dynamo.mark_dynamic(residual, 0)
+        outputs_unfused = model(x, residual)
+
+        model_fused = torch.compile(model, backend=backend)
+        outputs_fused = model_fused(x, residual)
+
+        # atol: one bf16 ulp at |residual| 4-8; only unfused rounds before the add.
+        torch.testing.assert_close(outputs_unfused, outputs_fused, atol=6e-2, rtol=2e-2)
+
+        if not fused_op_available:
+            # Without the AITER op the pass registers nothing; the graph stays unfused.
+            assert fusion_pass.matched_count == 0 and not input_ranks
+            assert all(backend.op_count(op) > 0 for op in model.ops_in_model_before())
+            assert backend.op_count(model.ops_in_model_after()[0]) == 0
+            return
+
+        assert fusion_pass.matched_count == num_layers
+        assert input_ranks and all(rank == 3 for rank in input_ranks)
+
+        backend.check_before_ops(model.ops_in_model_before())
+        backend.check_after_ops(model.ops_in_model_after())
+        # Gemma norms must take the Gemma form, which folds (1 + w) into the kernel.
+        fused_op = model.ops_in_model_after()[0]
+        names = [a.name for a in fused_op._schema.arguments]
+        fused = list(find_op_nodes(fused_op, backend.graph_post_pass))
+        assert fused and all(
+            dict(zip(names, n.args), **n.kwargs)["gemma_norm"] == gemma_norm
+            for n in fused
+        )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not is_aiter_found_and_supported(),
+    reason="Only test on ROCm with AITER installed and supported",
+)
+def test_fuse_gemm_add_rms_compile_range():
+    compilation_config = CompilationConfig(
+        pass_config=PassConfig(fuse_gemm_add_rms=True),
+    )
+    VllmConfig(
+        scheduler_config=SchedulerConfig(
+            max_num_batched_tokens=8192,
+            max_model_len=8192,
+            is_encoder_decoder=False,
+        ),
+        compilation_config=compilation_config,
+    )
+    assert compilation_config.get_compile_ranges() == [
+        Range(start=1, end=256),
+        Range(start=257, end=8192),
+    ]

@@ -1704,6 +1704,43 @@ def _rocm_aiter_triton_add_rmsnorm_pad_fake(
     return out, residual_out
 
 
+def _rocm_aiter_gemm_add_rmsnorm_impl(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    variance_epsilon: float,
+    gemma_norm: bool,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    from aiter.ops.triton.normalization.fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm import (
+        fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm,
+    )
+
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.utils import _rocm_unquantized_gemm
+
+    # A 3D result from a 2D input is the split-K partials, reduced by the norm kernel.
+    y = _rocm_unquantized_gemm(x.reshape(-1, x.size(-1)), weight, skip_reduce=True)
+    out, residual_out = fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm(
+        y,
+        residual.reshape(-1, residual.size(-1)),
+        norm_weight,
+        variance_epsilon,
+        gemma_norm=gemma_norm,
+    )
+    return out.view(residual.shape), residual_out.view(residual.shape)
+
+
+def _rocm_aiter_gemm_add_rmsnorm_fake(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    variance_epsilon: float,
+    gemma_norm: bool,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    return torch.empty_like(residual), torch.empty_like(residual)
+
+
 def _fused_mla_dual_rms_norm_impl(
     x1: torch.Tensor,
     x1_weight: torch.Tensor,
@@ -3186,6 +3223,13 @@ def register_ops_once() -> None:
                 dispatch_key=current_platform.dispatch_key,
             )
 
+            direct_register_custom_op(
+                op_name="rocm_aiter_gemm_add_rmsnorm",
+                op_func=_rocm_aiter_gemm_add_rmsnorm_impl,
+                fake_impl=_rocm_aiter_gemm_add_rmsnorm_fake,
+                dispatch_key=current_platform.dispatch_key,
+            )
+
             direct_register_custom_op(
                 op_name="rocm_aiter_group_fp8_quant",
                 op_func=_rocm_aiter_group_fp8_quant_impl,
@@ -3329,6 +3373,19 @@ def get_act_mul_fused_fp8_group_quant_op() -> OpOverload:
     def get_triton_add_rmsnorm_pad_op() -> OpOverload:
         return torch.ops.vllm.rocm_aiter_triton_add_rmsnorm_pad.default
 
+    @staticmethod
+    @functools.cache
+    def is_fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm_supported() -> bool:
+        try:
+            import aiter.ops.triton.normalization.fused_reduce_add_rmsnorm  # noqa: F401
+        except ImportError:
+            return False
+        return True
